invitation to get involved: at the recent meeting of the parish pastoral council, the desire for greater lay participation in our weekend parish masses was discussed . we would love to see more families and parishioners getting involved. there are a number of ways you can participate, including: reading at mass , leading the prayers of the faithful or bringing up the gifts of bread and wine . this can be especially meaningful at month’s mind or anniversary masses, when family members may wish to take part in remembering and praying for a loved one. we warmly invite you to consider getting involved. it would be wonderful to see more people taking an active part in our weekend masses. if you would like to participate, please contact fr. padraig or any member of the parish pastoral council. losing a loved one is one of life’s most challenging experiences . to help all who know this pain there will be a series of 4 tuesday evening talks on ‘how best to cope after a bereavement’ held in the newman centre, ballina on november 3rd, 10th, 17th and 24th from 8-10pm . the course will be presented by monica morley, bereavement counsellor at knock shrine. places are
